reason: I already paid for a mass-DM tool, got almost no replies and an action block, so anything that automates Instagram DMs makes me flinch. A card up front, a 3-day trial that bills on day 4 and payments final, and zero customer results at $147 a month is too much risk on under $5k a month.
objection: Nobody has published a result yet, and 3 days is not enough time to see replies from cold DMs. So I would be paying $147 for something that already got me an action block once, with no refund if it goes the same way.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from people at my size (replies and booked calls, with the account still fine), plus a refund window of 14 days or more instead of final payments after day 3.
